enchantment.yo_hooks.gentle_touch.desc: The grappling hook will not break fragile blocks such as glass or dripstone.
enchantment.yo_hooks.long_reach.desc: Increases the length of the grappling hook.
enchantment.yo_hooks.agility.desc: Speeds up grappling hook chain climb up and boosts the jump.
advancements.yo_hooks.adventure.sudden_f: Try to cling to a fragile block and fall to your death.
config.yo_hooks.common.desc: Synced from the server. Changes are only applied if you're playing in your own world.
config.yo_hooks.parameters.desc: Changes are only applied after a game restart! Range is synced from the server.
config.yo_hooks.funny_mode.desc: Disables fall damage, gives increased range and durability, and allows you to jump even when the hook is down — in short, everything for fun.
config.yo_hooks.soft_hook.desc: The hook becomes more elastic, like a spring.
config.yo_hooks.stiffness.desc: Only for soft rope mode. The higher the value, the less elastic the rope.
config.yo_hooks.climb_speed.desc: Increase to climb up and down faster.
config.yo_hooks.decrease_satiety.desc: How much hunger is consumed for a hook + jump from it. Climbing the chain also consumes hunger.
When attaching, the hook breaks fragile blocks: glass, dripstone, bamboo, ice, hanging sand and gravel, etc. This can also be prevented with the «Soft Touch» enchantment.
config.yo_hooks.blocks_blacklist.desc: Blocks that the hook cannot attach to. Example: "minecraft:dirt,minecraft:stone"
config.yo_hooks.whitelist_mode.desc: Enable this to allow the hook to latch onto only the blocks listed above, rather than ignoring them.
config.yo_hooks.hold_hook_tightly.desc: Scrolling the mouse wheel will not scroll the hotbar while you're hooked. Useful if you're worried about accidentally falling off.
config.yo_hooks.range.desc: Change the maximum range for this hook. Changes only apply after a game restart!
config.yo_hooks.durability.desc: Change the durability for this hook. Set to -1 for infinite durability. Changes only apply after a game restart!
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.yo_hooks: Adds vanilla-like and physically realistic grappling hooks.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.yo_hooks: Adds vanilla-like and physically realistic grappling hooks.
